say:3:1220440001:1.text: Lucca, Chippy knew it! You truly care about Stanton.
say:3:1220440001:1.source_cn: 卢卡，我就知道，你明明还是很在意斯坦顿的选择的……

say:4:1220440002:1.text: Mr. Lucca, why didn't you tell Stanton that you've already reached an agreement with the agent?
say:4:1220440002:1.source_cn: 卢卡先生，为什么不告诉斯坦顿，你已经和那位掮客先生谈妥了呢？

say:5:1220440003:1.text: Stanton thinks the agent has given up on him. If he's lured by the bookie's offer... that would be terrible!
say:5:1220440003:1.source_cn: 斯坦顿觉得拳击掮客已经放弃了他，万一他被庄家给出的利益...

say:6:1220440004:1.text: I told you, it's his own choice.
say:6:1220440004:1.source_cn: 我说了，这是他自己的选择。
say:6:1220440004:1.male: I told you, it's his own choice.
say:6:1220440004:1.female: I told you, it's his own choice.

choice_prompt:7:1220440004.text: I told you, it's his own choice.
choice_prompt:7:1220440004.source_cn: 我说了，这是他自己的选择。
choice_prompt:7:1220440004.male: I told you, it's his own choice.
choice_prompt:7:1220440004.female: I told you, it's his own choice.

say:8:1220440005:1.text: I want to see where his heart leads him.

say:9:1220440006:1.text: If he gives his all, regardless of the outcome, I'll handle things for him going forward. But if he chooses to throw the fight...
say:9:1220440006:1.source_cn: 如果他尽全力，无论胜负，之后的事我会为他摆平。但如果他...

say:10:1220440007:1.text: He won't throw the fight! Chippy believes in him!
say:10:1220440007:1.source_cn: 他不会打假拳的！满满相信他！

say:11:1220440008:1.text: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.
say:11:1220440008:1.source_cn: 当年我屈服了。为了活命，我跳进这个臭泥潭，挣扎着向上爬...
say:11:1220440008:1.male: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.
say:11:1220440008:1.female: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.

choice_prompt:12:1220440008.text: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.
choice_prompt:12:1220440008.source_cn: 当年我屈服了。为了活命，我跳进这个臭泥潭，挣扎着向上爬，还好有索尼娅拉了我一把。
choice_prompt:12:1220440008.male: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.
choice_prompt:12:1220440008.female: In the past, I gave in. To stay alive, I plunged into this filthy swamp, struggling to rise. Luckily, Sonja pulled me out.

say:13:1220440009:1.text: I hope he gives me the chance... Let's go see the fight.
say:13:1220440009:1.source_cn: 希望他能给我一个惊喜……走吧，去看看拳赛结果到底是什么。

choice:7:0:1.male: You want to test his resolve.
choice:7:0:1.female: You want to test his resolve.
